description: Per-pixel delta shadows smoke (XR-07, XR-08; developer build: -Asi Release\ApexRadiance.asi). Needs the bridge pair of patches 0019-0020 and the x64 d3d9.dll of native/dxvk in Bin. Real-Time Lighting on with pixelShadows and the filtered mask view through a 60 s pan. Variant sims: no test capsule, the Sims' own capsules (casters from the Sim draws): the counters line shows sims above 0 and rays above 0. Variant on (the default): the test capsule. Pass: no crash, the On line, a counters line with passes and rays above 0 and faults=0, no off or error line.
